versions.content: Definition of CompuScale Code Symbolic Name In C code, a CompuScale is represented by an identifier that is, as far as AUTOSAR mod- eling is concerned, called a CompuScale Symbolic Name . The CompuScale Code Symbolic Name may be taken from CompuScale . sym- bol , CompuConstTextContent . vt , or CompuScale . shortLabel . The details are explained in [TPS_SWCT_01431].
